fields.title: Ten-year retention
fields.finding: Warehouse extrapolation and .995/year protection target are not measured installed life. OD4 and white mass do not establish a durable coating.
fields.proposed_fix: Qualify combined light, humidity, stress, temperature, abrasion, fatigue and repair histories.

claim: Warehouse extrapolation and .995/year protection target are not measured installed life. OD4 and white mass do not establish a durable coating. | Ten-year retention
numerical_scope: Source NFI carried without a new independent check
qualification: Its WVTR 0.08 assumption, desiccant capacity, kinetics and unweighed hardware are not an assembled seven-day demonstration. The 059 pond values were not reproduced; both proposed pond routes remain surrogates. Bulk drying is not complete drying. [CHECK054](unpublished-local-ref:53985958be51c48e), [CHECK059](unpublished-local-ref:ab03a39f43a477d7).
